rounds.text: A calm blue palette for a banking app should lean on a deep, desaturated primary for trust, a softer slate for secondary elements, and a pale sky accent used sparingly. The text pairings below are meant to clear the WCAG AA floors (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and UI), and each card shows its rating so you can check them.
